summary.text: LaToya Bates is the Democratic candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 37 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Mark Born (R).
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Bates described herself as an educator, social entrepreneur and faith leader.

paragraphs.text: In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Bates said she is a former K-12 educator and the Founding Director of Wounded Wings, an association that serves survivors of sexual and domestic abuse.
She said she owns and manages Lauryn Wynter Company, a family-run event management group.
Bates said she earned bachelor's and master's degrees at Alverno College and a Master of Pastoral Studies from Cardinal Stritch University, and that she lives in Mayville and has two children.
Bates said she was elected a delegate representing the 6th Congressional District at the Democratic National Convention and a delegate for Dodge County at the Wisconsin Democratic Convention.
She ran for the same Assembly seat in 2024, advancing from the Democratic primary on August 13, 2024, and losing the general election to Born, 68.6 percent to 31.4 percent.
Bates advanced from the Democratic primary again on August 11, 2026.
In the 2024 survey, Bates named healthcare access, improving schools and educational programs, and lowering costs for families as her key messages.
